zh.title: ANA最新「寶可夢彩繪機 綠」今飛抵松山　JA923A執飛NH853航迷可拍攝
zh.summary: ANA最新「寶可夢彩繪機 綠」Boeing 787-9 JA923A於10月5日執飛NH853由東京羽田飛往臺北松山，讓臺灣航空迷有機會拍攝這架9月才投入國際線營運的最新彩繪機。
body: 全日空（ANA）最新推出的「寶可夢彩繪機 綠」（Green Pokémon Jet）今（5）日飛往臺灣。航班追蹤資料顯示，註冊編號JA923A的Boeing 787-9今日執飛NH853航班，由東京羽田機場（HND）飛往臺北松山機場（TSA），讓臺灣航空迷有機會近距離拍攝這架甫於9月投入國際線營運的最新寶可夢彩繪機。
NH853表定於日本時間下午1時20分自羽田起飛，臺北時間下午3時50分抵達松山。Flightradar24最新航班資料顯示，JA923A已於臺北時間下午1時37分左右起飛，目前預估約下午3時36分抵達，較原訂時間提前約14分鐘；實際抵達時間及使用跑道仍可能依當時航路、天候及航管安排調整。
JA923A為Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner，機型代碼B789。ANA以「與寶可夢一同踏上令人期待的旅程」為概念設計「寶可夢彩繪機 綠」，機身以綠色為主要視覺元素，並繪有皮卡丘及多隻初代寶可夢角色，是ANA配合《寶可夢》誕生30週年及ANA國際線開航40週年推出的新一代特別塗裝之一。
「寶可夢彩繪機 綠」於2026年9月18日正式投入國際線定期航班營運。ANA公布的主要運用航線包括自羽田出發前往檀香山、西雅圖、溫哥華、雪梨、馬尼拉、新加坡、新德里、曼谷、雅加達及吉隆坡，以及由成田出發前往曼谷、新加坡、雅加達、伯斯及孟買等航點。臺北並未列在原先公布的主要營運航線中，不過ANA也說明，實際派遣會依當日航機運作情況決定，特殊調度時可能投入名單以外的航線。
因此，JA923A今日執飛羽田－松山NH853屬於較少見的臺灣派遣。Flightradar24亦已將JA923A標示為ANA的「Pokémon Livery」787-9，並確認10月5日航班紀錄為NH853、目的地為臺北松山。
有意前往松山機場周邊拍攝的航空迷，可留意NH853最新航班動態及松山機場即時跑道使用情況。由於航機調度、抵達時間與進場跑道均可能臨時變更，實際拍攝仍應以即時航班資訊為準。

en.title: ANA's New Green Pokémon Jet Heads to Taipei Songshan on NH853, Giving Spotters a Chance to Photograph JA923A
en.summary: ANA's new Green Pokémon Jet, Boeing 787-9 JA923A, is operating NH853 from Tokyo Haneda to Taipei Songshan on October 5, offering aviation enthusiasts in Taiwan a chance to photograph the aircraft.
body: All Nippon Airways (ANA) is sending its newly introduced Green Pokémon Jet to Taiwan today, October 5. Flight-tracking data shows that Boeing 787-9 JA923A is operating flight NH853 from Tokyo Haneda Airport (HND) to Taipei Songshan Airport (TSA), giving aviation enthusiasts in Taiwan an opportunity to photograph the aircraft, which only entered international service in September.

NH853 is scheduled to depart Haneda at 1:20 p.m. Japan time and arrive at Songshan at 3:50 p.m. Taipei time. The latest Flightradar24 data shows JA923A departed at around 1:37 p.m. Taipei time and was estimated to arrive at about 3:36 p.m., roughly 14 minutes ahead of schedule. Actual arrival time and runway use may still change depending on routing, weather and air traffic control arrangements.

JA923A is a Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner with ICAO type code B789. ANA designed the Green Pokémon Jet around the concept of setting off on an exciting journey together with Pokémon. The aircraft uses green as its main visual theme and features Pikachu along with several first-generation Pokémon characters. It is one of ANA's new special liveries introduced to mark Pokémon's 30th anniversary and the 40th anniversary of ANA international service.

The Green Pokémon Jet officially entered scheduled international service on September 18, 2026. ANA's announced primary routes include services from Haneda to Honolulu, Seattle, Vancouver, Sydney, Manila, Singapore, New Delhi, Bangkok, Jakarta and Kuala Lumpur, as well as Narita services to Bangkok, Singapore, Jakarta, Perth and Mumbai. Taipei was not included in the originally published primary operating list, although ANA has stated that actual aircraft assignments depend on daily operations and that the aircraft may be deployed on other routes when required.

JA923A's assignment to the Haneda–Songshan NH853 service is therefore a relatively unusual Taiwan deployment. Flightradar24 also identifies JA923A as an ANA 787-9 in Pokémon livery and records its October 5 flight as NH853 bound for Taipei Songshan.

Aviation enthusiasts planning to photograph the aircraft around Songshan Airport should check the latest NH853 flight status and real-time runway use. Aircraft assignment, arrival time and approach runway can all change at short notice, so actual spotting conditions should be confirmed using current flight information.
